cards.ex: After making that incorrect prediction, he was forced to eat crow on live television.
cards.exUz: Noto'g'ri bashorat qilganidan so'ng, u jonli efirda xatosini tan olishga majbur bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: O'z xatosini tan olishga majbur bo'lish, ayniqsa uyatli vaziyatda.

cards.ex: The company had to tender an apology to its customers for the data breach.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya ma'lumotlar buzilishi uchun o'z mijozlaridan uzr so'rashga majbur bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Rasmiy yoki jiddiy uzr so'rash, ko'pincha yozma ravishda.

cards.ex: They decided to let bygones be bygones and start fresh after their argument.
cards.exUz: Ular janjaldan keyin o'tmishni unutib, yangidan boshlashga qaror qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: O'tmishdagi kelishmovchiliklarni unutib, yangi sahifa ochish.

cards.ex: Moving to a new city gave her a clean slate to reinvent herself.
cards.exUz: Yangi shaharga ko'chib o'tish unga o'zini qaytadan kashf qilish uchun yangi sahifa berdi.
cards.uzDef: Oldingi xatolarni unutib, yangidan boshlash imkoniyati.

cards.ex: It's time to bury the past and focus on building a better future together.
cards.exUz: O'tmishni ko'mib, birgalikda yaxshiroq kelajak qurishga e'tibor qaratish vaqti keldi.
cards.uzDef: O'tmishdagi muammolarni unutib, oldinga intilish.

cards.ex: He tried to make a gesture of goodwill by sending her flowers.
cards.exUz: U unga gullar yuborib, yaxshi niyat ko'rsatishga harakat qildi.
cards.uzDef: Kechirim so'rash yoki yarashish uchun imo-ishora qilish.

cards.ex: The politician publicly expressed remorse for his past actions.
cards.exUz: Siyosatchi o'zining o'tmishdagi harakatlari uchun omma oldida pushaymonligini bildirdi.
cards.uzDef: Qilgan ishidan afsusda ekanligini ko'rsatish.

cards.ex: They were at odds with each other over the direction of the company.
cards.exUz: Ular kompaniyaning yo'nalishi bo'yicha bir-biri bilan kelishmovchilikda edilar.
cards.uzDef: Kimdir bilan jiddiy kelishmovchilikda bo'lish.

cards.ex: She's the type of person who tends to hold a grudge for years.
cards.exUz: U ko'p yillar davomida gina saqlaydigan odam.
cards.uzDef: Kimdirga nisbatan achchiq hislarni saqlash, kechirmaslik.

cards.ex: Asking for a full apology after all this time might be a bridge too far.
cards.exUz: Buncha vaqtdan keyin to'liq uzr so'rashni talab qilish haddan oshish bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Qabul qilinishi qiyin bo'lgan narsa, haddan tashqari.

cards.ex: He practically got down on bended knee to ask for her forgiveness.
cards.exUz: U amalda tiz cho'kib, undan kechirim so'radi.
cards.uzDef: Yalinchlik bilan uzr so'rash yoki iltimos qilish.

cards.ex: It takes a strong person to extend forgiveness to someone who has hurt them.
cards.exUz: O'ziga zarar yetkazgan odamni kechirish uchun kuchli inson bo'lish kerak.
cards.uzDef: Kechirishni taklif qilish, kechirishga rozi bo'lish.

cards.ex: His parents let him off the hook for breaking curfew because it was his birthday.
cards.exUz: Ota-onasi uni tug'ilgan kuni bo'lgani uchun komendantlik soatini buzgani uchun jazolamadi.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir jazolamaslik yoki javobgarlikdan ozod qilish.

cards.ex: I'm really sorry I missed your birthday. I'll make it up to you!
cards.exUz: Tug'ilgan kuningni o'tkazib yuborganim uchun juda afsusdaman. Men buni qoplayman!
cards.uzDef: Qilgan xato uchun kompensatsiya berishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: The manager chose to turn a blind eye to the employee's inappropriate behavior.
cards.exUz: Menejer xodimning nomaqbul xatti-harakatlariga ko'z yumishni tanladi.
cards.uzDef: Noto'g'ri ishni bilib turib e'tibor bermaslik.

cards.ex: I take exception to the way you're speaking to me.
cards.exUz: Sizning men bilan gaplashayotgan uslubingizga e'tiroz bildiraman.
cards.uzDef: Nimagadir qarshi ekanligini bildirish, norozilik bildirish.

cards.ex: Neither side was willing to back down, so the argument continued.
cards.exUz: Hech bir tomon taslim bo'lishni xohlamadi, shuning uchun bahs davom etdi.
cards.uzDef: Munozaradan yoki talabdan voz kechish.

cards.ex: The company needs to acknowledge its wrongdoing and take steps to prevent it from happening again.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya o'z xatolarini tan olishi va uning qayta sodir bo'lishining oldini olish uchun choralar ko'rishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Qilgan xato ishni tan olish va javobgarlikni o'z zimmasiga olish.

cards.ex: She made a sincere apology to her friend for forgetting her birthday.
cards.exUz: U dugonasining tug'ilgan kunini unutgani uchun chin dildan uzr so'radi.
cards.uzDef: Chin yurakdan uzr so'rash, afsuslanishni bildirish.

cards.ex: I understand you made a mistake; to err is human, after all.
cards.exUz: Siz xato qilganingizni tushunaman; axir, xato qilish odamiylikdan.
cards.uzDef: Hamma odamlar xato qilishadi, xato qilish tabiiy hol.

cards.ex: We need to hold those responsible for the scandal accountable for their actions.
cards.exUz: Biz janjalga sabab bo'lganlarni o'z harakatlari uchun javobgarlikka tortishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir xatti-harakatlari uchun javobgarlikni yuklash.

cards.ex: Despite their disagreement, they remained on good terms.
cards.exUz: Kelishmovchiliklariga qaramay, ular yaxshi munosabatda qolishdi.
cards.uzDef: Kimdir bilan do'stona va yaxshi munosabatlarda bo'lish.

cards.ex: The CEO's fall from grace was swift after the scandal broke.
cards.exUz: Janjal yuzaga kelganidan keyin bosh direktorning hurmatdan tushishi tez bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Yuqori lavozim yoki hurmatni yo'qotish.

cards.ex: I'm having second thoughts about forgiving him after what he did.
cards.exUz: U qilgan ishidan keyin uni kechirish haqida ikkinchi fikrda bo'lyapman.
cards.uzDef: Qabul qilingan qaror haqida shubhalanish.

cards.ex: He decided to turn over a new leaf and start being more responsible.
cards.exUz: U yangi hayot boshlashga va yanada mas'uliyatli bo'lishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Xulq-atvorni yaxshilash uchun yangi boshlash.

cards.ex: That argument is water under the bridge now; let's move on.
cards.exUz: Bu bahs endi o'tmishda qoldi; keling, oldinga intilamiz.
cards.uzDef: O'tmishda bo'lib o'tgan va endi ahamiyati yo'q narsa.

cards.ex: I didn't want to apologize, but I had to bite the bullet and do it.
cards.exUz: Men uzr so'rashni xohlamadim, lekin bardosh berishga va buni qilishga majbur bo'ldim.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin yoki yoqimsiz vaziyatga bardosh berish.

cards.ex: He refused to acknowledge responsibility for the accident.
cards.exUz: U baxtsiz hodisa uchun mas'uliyatni tan olishdan bosh tortdi.
cards.uzDef: Qilgan ishi uchun mas'uliyatni o'z zimmasiga olish.

cards.ex: Old grievances should fall by the wayside now that they are trying to reconcile.
cards.exUz: Endi ular yarashishga harakat qilayotgan ekan, eski noroziliklar unutilishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Unutilib ketmoq, e'tibordan chetda qolmoq.

cards.ex: After being caught, he had no choice but to beg for mercy.
cards.exUz: Qo'lga tushgandan so'ng, uning rahm so'rashdan boshqa chorasi qolmadi.
cards.uzDef: Rahm-shafqat so'rash, kechirim so'rash.
